Sincerely,
Sergio de Nimes

contents.text: You can use adverbs to compare actions.
Comparative adverbs compare the actions of a person, thing, or group to the actions of some other person, thing, or group.
Superlative adverbs compare the actions of a person, thing, or group to the actions of a larger group that it is part of.

header.text: For adverbs that have one syllable, add -er to make the comparative adverb. Add -est to make the superlative adverb. If the base ends in e, drop the e before adding -er or -est.
For adverbs that have more than one syllable, add more to make the comparative adverb. Add most to make the superlative adverb.
For the adverb early, drop the y and add -ier to make the comparative adverb. Add -iest to make the superlative adverb.
